# Top Speed Appliances

Top Speed Appliances is the used-appliance shop of Top Speed Appliance LLC, part of the Top Speed Service OS ecosystem. Slogan: "The Faster, The Better."

## What this shop is
- Sells quality used appliances that are inspected and tested by Top Speed technicians before listing.
- Inventory is listed as it becomes available. When no products are listed, inventory is being inspected and listed — call to ask about what you need.
- Delivery and pickup are available on marked items; each product page states what applies to that item.
- Warranty days, when applicable, are shown on each product from its own record. There is no single blanket warranty promise on this page.

## Categories
Refrigerators, Washers, Dryers, Ovens & Ranges, Dishwashers, Freezers & Ice Makers, Microwaves, Garbage Disposals, and other appliances.

## Ordering
Orders are placed on the shop cart page. An order is confirmed once payment completes; payment status is confirmed by the payment provider, not by the shop page alone.
